title: BRIDGING JENSEN GAP FOR MAX-MIN GROUP FAIRNESS OPTIMIZATION IN RECOMMENDATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating recommender system accuracy and fairness using metrics like NDCG, MRR, and Max-Min Fairness (MMF@K) to measure the aggregated ranking score (exposure) of the most disadvantaged item groups (e.g., small sellers, infrequent categories).
Analyzing the impact of popularity bias on accuracy estimation and utilizing Inverse Propensity Score (IPS) reweighting to observe changes in fairness and accuracy metrics.
